$comment: The footer of the public export (krizaka-internal#4635, the pattern of verikora#914): grouped columns of the pages the export holds, the legal line, no version. Words are keys of `t.landing.footer`; a link names a page of the export (`page`, a folder of scripts/public-routes.mjs, "" is the home) or one of the site's addresses (`site`), never a typed URL. The product column carries the product's status from @krizaka/org. Read by src/features/landing/utils/public-footer.ts.
